The later SDK-fixture copy, positive SDK tests, quality wiring, documentation, and plan integration remain separate gates. This result is not whole-J005 delivery approval, merge permission, or product acceptance.

- Worker compatibility and cessation probes passed: capacity, route admission, and capacity API tests.
